Maria G.: Quick note - noticed a cluster of tenants showing tokens on both v1 and v2 after the v2 soft-launch in eu-west. Looks like attribution is duplicated in telemetry which is inflating billing previews.

Kevin L.: I ran a few traces. Root cause: routing decision emits route=v1 (for compatibility) but the telemetry enrichment job sometimes tags model_variant=v2 because the model selection happened earlier in the pipeline. Downstream join ends up double-counting.

Anil S.: Can you paste an example trace id? I want to check where the enrich happens.

Maria G.: trace: trace_2024_8823. Quick snippet from logs:
```
2024-06-10T09:12:04Z routing: chosen=compat_fallback(v1) tenant=acme-prod trace=trace_2024_8823 tokens=1234
2024-06-10T09:12:04Z model_select: model=v2-large variant_id=2a trace=trace_2024_8823
```
So two different fields being used for attribution.

Sasha P.: UX note: Console rollforward preview currently reads the telemetry stream and shows an "expected billing" row. That row is showing +6% for acme-prod which will alarm customers. We need a short-term fix before we flip more tenants.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-345 for duplicated attribution telemetry (https://redwood/incidents/INC-2026-345)

Kevin L.: Short-term mitigation idea: canonicalize attribution at the routing layer by setting header `X-Compat-Attribution: v1` or `v2` as the single source of truth. ETL should prefer that header when present. This avoids relying on model_select or route fields that can diverge.

Anil S.: Agree. Implementation notes:
- Routing: set `X-Compat-Attribution` at the policy decision point before handing request to model selection.
- Enrichment: if enrichment job sets model_variant, do NOT override `X-Compat-Attribution` header.
- ETL: add precedence rule: use `X-Compat-Attribution` if present; otherwise fall back to existing logic.
Estimate: routing change ~6-8 hrs (incl tests), ETL change ~half day, enrichment safeguard ~3-4 hrs.

Lia M.: From comms: Let's hold any tenant-facing rollforwards until we've validated a 1% sample window after the fix. Also prepare a short note for tenants if they saw unexpected deltas. I'll draft.

Sasha P.: UI follow-up: I'll add a new "Attribution check" step in the console rollforward preview. The preview endpoint will return:
- sample_count
- estimated_billing_delta
- sample_trace_ids (5)
We can show a pill: "Attribution status: canonicalized" or "Attribution mismatch detected" with a link to sample traces.

Maria G.: I'll open the routing PR and add unit/integration tests for header propagation. Kevin, can you add ETL precedence in the next pipeline deploy? Anil, can you add the enrichment no-overwrite guard? Sasha, can you mock the API payload for the preview endpoint (we can reuse current preview path /api/rollforward/preview).

Kevin L.: Will do. Also planning a 1% backfill re-run using the new precedence to validate totals before full reprocess. Will monitor cluster CPU during the backfill.

Anil S.: I'll push the enrichment change to staging and run a few sample traces to confirm header persists to the telemetry topic.

Maria G.: Owners: Maria (routing PR), Kevin (ETL + backfill), Anil (enrichment guard), Sasha (console preview), Lia (comms). Tagging @ops-bot for scheduled backfill window. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Acknowledged - will coordinate a low-impact backfill window and page oncall if system load > 70% during backfill.

Kevin L.: Quick rollback plan if backfill spikes: pause backfill, revert ETL precedence change, and toggle console preview to show sample-only data until we can re-run.

Lia M.: I'll queue the tenant note and wait for Kevin's green before sending.

Maria G.: Thanks team. Let's aim to ship the routing header by EOD and a staged ETL deploy first thing tomorrow. I'll update INC-2026-345 with progress.
